items.mainDefect: The migration reads execute(...)[0]['id'] without checking that a row exists, so it raises NoMethodError when the result is empty.

secondary.defect: The migration puts the host value straight into the INSERT SQL without escaping or parameters.

items.mainDefect: The plural branch in Store hydration calls obj[k].map without checking for an array, so it throws a TypeError when category_ids is null, missing or a single value.

secondary.defect: Ids missing from the root payload come back as undefined from _lookupSubType and stay as undefined entries in the hydrated array.

items.mainDefect: The admin embeddable hosts controller does not handle a nil host after the lookup in update and destroy, so it dereferences nil.

secondary.defect: save_host does not guard against a missing params[:embeddable_host] and dereferences nil params.

items.mainDefect: The migration inserts raw SiteSetting host values without removing the scheme and path the way the model does, so host_allowed? never matches migrated hosts.

secondary.defect: The migration INSERT interpolates the host value into SQL without sanitizing it.

items.mainDefect: The migration inserts host values without removing the scheme and path like the model's before_validation does, so host_allowed? never finds migrated hosts.

secondary.defect: The migration INSERT interpolates the host into SQL without escaping or parameters.

items.mainDefect: The migration writes raw SiteSetting values that still include the protocol and path to embeddable_hosts.host, which do not match the model's normalized lookup, so migrated hosts cannot be reached.

secondary.defect: The migration INSERT uses string interpolation instead of bound parameters.
